text: The authors state that their judge-debater expertise gap, based on asymmetric access to textual information, may not be the best proxy for future expertise gaps such as in reasoning abilities, and that they focus only on reading comprehension questions, for which Kenton et al. (2024) found debate more helpful than for other reasoning tasks.
title: Information-only expertise gap may poorly proxy reasoning gaps; reading comprehension only
